name: Yune Sekiei
source:
Age: ??
Character theme: Hope

A young boy revered by The Heavens as the Shinkan, a being supposedly loved by God. Though his status makes him hard to approach, he laugh innocently sometimes like a child, and has a personality that’s hard to grasp.

"It’s simple. You just have to fall in love with me."

[From [url=https://riebakkari.wordpress.com/2016/07/02/steam-prison-introduction/]Rie's Otoge Blog[/url]]
